name: Achensee Schifffahrt
kurzbeschreibung: Achensee Passenger Shipping has operated since 1887, linking picturesque shoreline ports across Tirol's largest lake with a modern panoramic cruising fleet.
preis: Fares depend on route (complete circular cruise approx. 24–28 €; family discounts available)
oeffnungszeiten: Regular service late April to late October; festive Advent cruises in December
beschreibung:
Überblick

The storied Achensee Shipping Company (Achenseeschifffahrt) has defined maritime leisure across Tirol's grandest mountain lake since 1887, harmoniously uniting maritime heritage with contemporary cruise comfort. Originating with the historic paddle steamer 'St. Josef', the service operates today with a fleet of clean, state-of-the-art passenger motor vessels navigating the 929-metre-high waters. Gliding smoothly across the lake's 133-metre depths, ships like the flagship MS Achensee, MS Tirol, and the stylish MS Stadt Innsbruck afford spectacular water-level vistas of vertical Karwendel cliffs and the soaring limestone bastions of the Rofan range. The scheduled route knits together scenic lakeside terminals at Pertisau, Seespitz, Maurach, Buchau, and Scholastika, alongside the roadless Gaisalm mountain retreat.

Route & Anforderungen

Cruising on Lake Achensee is a fully accessible, weatherproof highlight suitable for travelers of all generations. Vessels operate on a regular scheduled timetable linking the six designated piers, with a complete grand lake loop requiring approximately two hours. Passenger ships boast spacious open-air sun decks alongside climate-controlled indoor panoramic salons equipped with full galley catering. A favored excursion strategy is hopping off at the foot of mountain trails: guests frequently cruise from Pertisau to the isolated Gaisalm pasture, explore surrounding footpaths, and re-embark on a later scheduled sailing. Boarding gangways and passenger salons are fully barrier-free, comfortably accommodating strollers and wheelchairs.

Besuch & Anreise

Primary embarkation piers are located at Pertisau, Maurach, and Seespitz at the southern end, and Scholastika (Achenkirch) at the northern tip. Road access leads from motorway A12 (exit Wiesing/Achensee) via federal road B181 to lakeside car parks. Rail visitors alight at Jenbach and transfer to the vintage steam Achenseebahn cog railway, which terminates directly alongside the dock at Seespitz for an effortless connection.

Tipps

Purchase the historic combined steam train and boat ticket for a nostalgic journey ascending from the Inn Valley directly onto the cruise deck. In December, festive Christmas market cruises feature artisan stalls, warm glühwein, and brass carolers floating beneath snowcapped crags.
